text: Products can be returned if they are undamaged and complete. You are allowed to try the product, but items showing signs of use will not be accepted. For a return, the order number is sufficient; an invoice is not required. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date; after 30 days, return requests are not accepted and the product will be evaluated under warranty. If you use the contracted shipping company Anadolu Kargo for the return, the shipping is free by showing the return code at the branch. If you send the product with your own courier, the shipping cost will not be refunded. Once the product arrives at the warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, the refund will be made to the account holder's IBAN number.
